item.title: Bistro Ibarra Tagaytay Birthday Lunch Buffet: 4+1 Promo!
item.description: 🎉 Celebrate Your Birthday with a Feast at Bistro Ibarra Tagaytay! Make your birthday extra special with a scenic buffet celebration at Bistro Ibarra Tagaytay!
